# cosmo_clients (Data Source)

Lists the clients registered on a federated graph. Clients group persisted operations and are created implicitly when operations are first published for them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cosmo_clients" "test" {
  federated_graph_name = var.federated_graph_name
  namespace            = var.namespace
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `federated_graph_name` (String) The name of the federated graph.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the federated graph. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `clients` (Attributes List) The clients registered on the federated graph. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clients))

<a id="nestedatt--clients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clients`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The time the client was created.
- `created_by` (String) The user that created the client.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the client.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The time the client was last updated.
- `last_updated_by` (String) The user that last updated the client.
- `name` (String) The name of the client.
- `persisted_operations_count` (Number) The number of persisted operations registered for the client.
